What you can verify before you buy

Certified origin

Every stone ships with a lab report stating weight, treatment status and origin, so you know exactly what you are paying for.

Chart-first advice

We read your kundli before recommending a stone, and we will tell you when a gem is not needed.

Set by hand

Rings and pendants are set in 92.5 silver or 22k gold, sized to your finger, and ready to wear.
